summary: Greenland Mines Ltd filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a best-efforts public offering of 4,000,000 shares at $5.00 per share, with pre-funded warrants at $4.9999 to avoid beneficial ownership limits. A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners is the sole placement agent, with no minimum offering amount. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation, so it is classified as None. The offering terminates September 21, 2026, and proceeds are undetermined; watch pricing and take-up as placement agent efforts are not guaranteed.
